about.title: A fullstack profile built around readable architecture, API boundaries, and practical delivery.
about.intro: This portfolio makes my engineering decisions visible: what problem each project solves, how the frontend talks to the backend, where data and validation live, and how I think about maintainability.
about.cardTitle: Angular craft with Laravel and data context.
paragraphs: I am Jesus Martinez Escobar, a fullstack developer focused on Angular applications, Laravel APIs, and database-backed product workflows. I try to write code another developer can understand, test, and extend without reverse-engineering the intent.
The projects are presented as engineering cases: product problem, API/UI decisions, architecture, testing approach, and the tradeoffs I would discuss in an interview.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy explains how jesusdev.dev handles data in a minimal developer portfolio context.

overview.title: Overview
items: This site is a personal developer portfolio hosted on GitHub Pages.
It does not collect sensitive personal data or provide account registration.

data.title: Data collected
items: The site may receive standard technical request data from hosting infrastructure, such as browser, device, and IP-related logs.
If you contact me by email, I will receive the information you choose to send.

storage.title: LocalStorage
items: The selected language is stored in localStorage so the site can restore it on refresh.
Cookie consent is stored in localStorage so the banner does not reappear after a choice.

hosting.title: Hosting
items: The site is deployed through GitHub Pages.
GitHub may process basic technical data needed to serve the website.

cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
items: Essential preferences may be stored locally for language and consent.
Non-essential analytics cookies are only intended for basic usage understanding and can be rejected.

contact.title: Contact
items: For privacy questions, use the contact action on this page.
